chunks: Delay an evil because you will be able to hasten it whenever you desire.
The disregard of kinship of the ignorant is equal to the regard for kinship of the wise.
Whoever takes the world to be safe, it will betray him. Whoever regards the world as great, it will humiliate him.
Every one who shoots does not hit.
When authority changes, the time changes too.
Consult the friend before adopting a course and the neighbour before taking a house.
Beware, lest you mention in your speech what may rouse laughter even though you may be relating it from others.

key_terms.الزَّمَانُ: The world/time/era, often referring to the changing circumstances of life or history

ai.seo_question: What are the key principles of social and personal ethics in Imam Ali's instructions to Hasan?
ai.summary: Attributed to Imam Ali’s counsel to his son Hasan following the Battle of Siffin, this passage reflects the pragmatic political realism and ethical vigilance characteristic of the late Umayyad transition. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *hikmah* (wisdom) in navigating social instability, highlighting how personal conduct and choice of companions directly influence one's standing amidst shifting authorities. The advice serves as a guide for maintaining dignity and discernment in both private interactions and public life.
